source: SH-2E emulator dynamic execution (utilities/scripts/emu, tests/test_phase1_dynamic.py) + ROM bytes + Sh7055h.pdf

00003238.evidence: jsr target of every IVT trampoline at 0x28c0-0x30d0 (literals all = 0x3238). Dynamically executed on every cpu.interrupt in the emulator: saves r2-r7, fr0-fr11, fpscr, fpul (0x324a-0x326e), raises SR mask from ctrl block field +0x10, bumps counter at +0x8, rts to LAB_00003280 restore path.

00003e10.evidence: Called via literal at 0x9f38 during boot. Sets DAT_ffff7648=0xb0, task table ptr DAT_ffff7650=&DAT_00004990, current task DAT_ffff764c=&DAT_ffff7408, then calls dispatcher 0x3c2a. Emulator boot trace passes through it before reaching idle 0x3dac.

00003c2a.evidence: If ctrl+6 (0xffff763e) != -1 then 0x3c68 runs a task; else inits ctrl block (0x80000000, 0xffff, task table 0x4990) and enters idle loop 0x3dac. Emulator: harness.call(0x3c2a, stop_at=0x3dac) reaches idle.

0000375c.evidence: Sets ctrl+4 = task index, ctrl+0x18 = task record (0x4990 + idx*0x10), ctrl+0x14 = stack ptr from PTR_DAT_00004994[idx], then computed jump via PTR_FUN_00004998[idx] (task table 0x4998). Emulator: vec-0x378 handler reaches it via 0x9630.

00003db0.evidence: Called from ref_setSR (0x3934, call-site literal 0x3950). If DAT_ffff763c != DAT_ffff763e and (DAT_ffff7640 & 0x1000)==0: sets 0xffff7640=0x100, calls 0x3bf4 (context switch). Task-dispatch wake on ISR exit.

00011d88.evidence: Emulator dynamic: after can.inject(0x7e0, 02 10 03 ...) raises IVT 0x378, a plain emu.run executes 0x11d88 which calls 0x9c8e/0xce24 (pending = byteswap(~MBIMR & RXPR)), ref_placeCANRX(0x4dffc) copies MD14 into 0xffffddc8 (observed 02100300), clears RXPR; with latch DAT_ffff9ec8 bit0 set it tail-calls 0x680a0(0x7e0).

00009c8e.evidence: Wrapper: r0 = 0xce24(0); called at 0x11dba/0x11e4c in the CAN RX poll.

0000ce24.evidence: returns byteswap(~HCAN0_MBIMR_W & *(u16*)0xffffe40e) = byteswap(~MBIMR & RXPR). Emulator: inject sets RXPR=0x40 so this returns 0x4000.

0000cee8.evidence: reg + 0x200 if mb > 0x1f (HCAN1 block at 0xffffe600); else reg. Used by all mailbox accessors.

0000cf12.evidence: returns *(i16*)(0xd914 + (mb&0xf)*2) from the ROM mask table; mask = 1<<((mb+8)&0xf), e.g. mb14 -> 0x40, mb15 -> 0x80 (verified vs ROM bytes at 0xd914 and emulator RXPR bits).

0000ccda.evidence: FUN_00009e26(len, 0, payload, MD(mb)) - copies payload into mailbox data (TX side of ref_txCAN_EventBased 0x99b0).

0000cca4.evidence: FUN_00009dfc(len, 0, payload, MD(mb)) - copies mailbox data out (RX side of ref_placeCANRX 0x9890).

0000cd40.evidence: returns MC[mb][0] & 0xf (DLC stored in MC byte 0 by FUN_00001ed0). Emulator: TX of desc 0x4e00c emitted an 8-byte frame on 0x7e8.

000680a0.evidence: Emulator dynamic: harness.call(0x680a0, r4=0x7e0) after buffer fill -> PCI byte check via 0x683d4, service dispatch 0x6842c, then 0x684b4(0x7e0) schedules the UDS service task via ref_osTaskScheduler(2,0,&local).

000684b4.evidence: Calls 0x68b22(DAT_ffffddec), 0x68bc6(1,0x28), thunk 0x54b2c, ref_osTaskScheduler(2,0,&local_14). Executed in emulator while serving 10 03.

00009890.evidence: was ref_placeCANRX. Emulator dynamic: returns 0 and copies MD14 into desc buffer 0xffffddc8, clears RXPR, when RXPR bit set and UMSR bit clear; W1C semantics of RXPR/UMSR confirmed.

000008cc.evidence: Contains the poll at 0x8ea: mov.w @(0xffffed18) & 0x8000 (ICR_W bit15 = NMI pin level, Sh7055h.pdf 7.3.2) until set. Emulator: with NMI modeled low, boot hangs exactly here (pc 0x8ea, 1 mmio write); with SYSC nmi_level=1 boot reaches idle 0x3dac.

000009c0.evidence: MCR |= 1 then waits GSR bit3 (0x08) set, 4000-iteration timeout. Emulator: with the GSR handshake modeled, boot passes; without it boot spun here forever.

000009de.evidence: MCR &= ~1, waits GSR bit3 clear. Pairs with 0x9c0 (HCAN1 copies at 0x1e94/0x1eb2).

000077f0.evidence: Reads ATUII_ICR0AH_W (0xfffff434) into 0xffff9fb8 and ATUII_ICR10AH_W (0xfffff6d0) into 0xffff9fb0, computes period into 0xffff9fa8. Emulator: ICR values tracked the virtual crank wheel (set_rpm) when called via harness.

0000803e.evidence: was ref_INT_ATU101_IMI10AG (misnomer). Vector 0x2c8 (CMI10B; IVT at VBR 0x7fc50). Sums the 6-entry ring at 0xffff9fd0 into crank_period_accumulator_ffff9f88, sets engine_speed_rpm_raw_ffff9f80 = 1.2e8/sum. Emulator: fired via cpu.interrupt(0x2c8), executed, returned to idle.

00007778.evidence: was ref_setInterruptTimer. Clears TSR10 (write 0xb), calls 0x7b58 (OCR10B from table 0xd76d[DAT_ffff9f95*2]&0x7f, TCNT10B=0), sets TIER10 bit2 (CMFB). OS tick setup; ch10 started by TSTR3 bit0 (0xfffff402).

00006884.evidence: was ref_sensorADCRead. Starts ADCSR0/1/2 scans, ADST via ADCR 0x20, busy-waits ADCSR bit7 (ADF), then copies ADDR0H..ADDR31H into 0xffff9ee4..0xffff9f22 (maf ADDR3H -> 0xffff9eea, apv ADDR6H -> 0xffff9ef0, knock ADDR10H -> 0xffff9ef8). Emulator: harness.call(0x6884) landed scripted channels in those RAM cells.

00006744.evidence: was ref_getVehicleStatusInputs_. DAT_ffff9ec8 = PFDR_W (0xfffff74e), DAT_ffff9eca = PHDR_W, plus 3 GPIO inputs. Emulator: PFDR bit0 scripted high via GPIO inputs; read observed during the CAN-RX tick.

00006fb0.evidence: was ref_readADCResult. Starts an ADCSR2 conversion, waits ADF, returns ADDR24H_B (0xfffff848); bank-2 channel select (ADCSR2 at 0xfffff858).; 2026-11-05: body re-read 2026-11-05: polls ADC bank-2 control regs ADCSR2_B/ADCR2_B (clear SCAN/ADF, manage ADST) then reads results; caller knock_reference_adc_read 0xc276; byte-exact function match in 10/10 other ROMs (cross_rom_function_matches.tsv)

00006cdc.evidence: was ref_readADCs_coolantTempInHere__. Reads ADDR24H-ADDR31H into 0xffff9f14-0xffff9f22 when DAT_ffff9f31 selects the group (ECT ADDR28H -> 0xffff9f1c, IAT ADDR29H -> 0xffff9f1e per fueling labels).; 2026-11-05: dynamically verified 2026-11-05 in the SH-2E emulator (harness.call, profile 60E15120_N3J1E): with ADC group selector ffff9f31=8, AN28-31 raw values land exactly in ffff9f1c/9f1e/9f20/9f22 (9000/2500/111/222 observed) - ECT/IAT group read; byte-exact function match in 10/10 other ROMs (cross_rom_function_matches.tsv)
